scope_note: Normalized record of the final conditions used for the reported formal Phase A and unseen-topic analyses. Condition-specific repair calls replaced failed conditions and did not create additional statistical samples.

profiles.controlled_difference: P1, P2, and P3 differ only in math, programming, statistics, and subject-prior knowledge scores (1, 3, and 5 respectively); English remains 3 and all other profile fields are held constant.

formal_phase_a.reading_condition: Reading outputs used a frozen, controlled catalog; third-party course-material full text is not redistributed in this package.

unseen_topics.default_contract_definition: The learner profile was empty; the existing agents therefore used their intermediate-leaning fallback output contract. This was not a label-neutral absence-of-profile baseline.

excluded_from_this_record: debug runs that were not statistical samples
